page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and bzip3 decompression, alongside a bottom 10% rating in single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 32 dedicated cores compensate in multi-threaded scenarios, delivering average performance in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached operations also falls within the average range.

Given its high memory density and average multi-core performance, the ecs.se1.8xlarge is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high single-thread processing speeds. Appropriate use cases include database operations, Redis caching layers, and static web serving, where its average performance in Passmark database operations and Redis SET benchmarks is highly relevant. Qualitatively, the instance offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-heavy applications that benefit from a large RAM footprint without requiring expensive high-frequency CPUs or local NVMe storage.
